water-pollution.name: Water pollution
water-pollution.line: I see our rivers, lakes and drinking water getting polluted.

sources.passage: Pollution of drinking water 54 26 20 (Gallup, March 3-16, 2025; % worry a great deal / fair amount / only a little or not at all)
Pollution of rivers, lakes, and reservoirs 51 29 19 (Gallup, March 3-16, 2025; % worry a great deal / fair amount / only a little or not at all)
Pollution of rivers, lakes and ground water 38 (EU-27, 2020, %)
In 2022, globally, at least 1.7 billion people use a drinking water source contaminated with faeces.

water-pollution.prevalence: Pollution of drinking water is the top environmental worry in the U.S.: 54% worry a great deal, and 51% about rivers, lakes, and reservoirs (Gallup, 2025). 38% of Europeans name pollution of rivers, lakes and ground water among the most important issues (2020). At least 1.7 billion people use a drinking water source contaminated with faeces (WHO, 2022).

trash-and-plastic.name: Trash and plastic
trash-and-plastic.line: I see trash and plastic piling up with nowhere for it to go.

sources.passage: Management of waste produce in the U.S., including trash and recyclables 41 34 25 (Gallup, March 3-16, 2025; % worry a great deal / fair amount / only a little or not at all)

trash-and-plastic.prevalence: 41% of Americans worry a great deal about the management of trash and recyclables (Gallup, 2025). 45% of Europeans name the growing amount of waste among the most important environmental issues (2020).

water-shortages.name: Water shortages
water-shortages.line: I worry my area is running out of water.
water-shortages.prevalence: 25% of Europeans name shortage of drinking water among the most important environmental issues (2020).

toxic-chemicals.name: Toxic chemicals
toxic-chemicals.line: I worry about lead and toxic chemicals in our soil, water and homes.

sources.passage: Slightly more than half also worry a great deal about the pollution of rivers, lakes, and reservoirs and about soil and water contamination by toxic waste. (Gallup, 2024)
Lead exposure was attributed to more than 3.5 million deaths globally in 2023, primarily due to cardiovascular effects.

toxic-chemicals.prevalence: Slightly more than half of Americans worry a great deal about soil and water contamination by toxic waste (Gallup, 2024). Lead exposure was linked to more than 3.5 million deaths worldwide in 2023 (WHO). 32% of Europeans name agricultural pollution and soil degradation among the most important issues (2020).

noise.name: Noise
noise.line: I can't get away from traffic and other noise where I live.

sources.passage: at least one in five people in the EU are exposed to long-term noise levels considered harmful to their health. About 92 million people are exposed to harmful day-evening-night noise levels caused by road traffic.

noise.prevalence: At least one in five people in the EU live with long-term noise levels considered harmful to health; about 92 million are exposed to harmful road traffic noise (European Environment Agency). 8% of Europeans name noise among the most important environmental issues (2020).
